claim_reviews.review: Accurately describes pay for work beyond regular hours.
“Upah lembur” is a valid Indonesian expression.
“Bayaran kerja lebih masa” is a valid Malaysian Malay expression.
The forms differ lexically while expressing the same concept.
The English cue clearly identifies the intended meaning.

rationale: English sense is accurate, and both Indonesian “upah lembur” and Malaysian Malay “bayaran kerja lebih masa” appropriately express overtime pay. The different-common-word relation is valid; the colloquial Indonesian alternative “uang lembur” does not make the proposed answer incorrect.
